description: This file defines a Java class 'ReadOnlyMapEntry' that implements the Map.Entry interface, providing an immutable key-value pair with custom implementations of 'equals' and 'hashCode'. It serves as a read-only map entry used within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ReadOnlyMapEntry
classes.description: An immutable implementation of Map.Entry with overridden equals and hashCode methods, used for read-only map entries within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ReadOnlyMapEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing the key and value of the read-only map entry.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key of the entry.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the entry.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another Map.Entry based on key and value equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on key and value using UtilObject.doHashCode.
